restore_episode_from_protobuf: restore a minitaur episode from a protobuf log file using MinitaurLogging
extract_motor_states: extract motor angle, velocity, action, and torque from episode records
list_episode_fields: list all fields in a restored protobuf episode using ListFields
save_motor_data_to_csv: save motor state data to a CSV file using numpy savetxt
run_proto_dump_cli: run the minitaur proto dump CLI script with a log file path argument
